full_reconciliation: startup/resume and before final publication; portable non-Windows fallback on periodic refresh
notification_failure: overflow, malformed notification, inaccessible path, changed root, lost handle: fail closed with existing failure/STOP evidence; no recovery or silent fallback

limits: unchanged 128 GiB retained logical bytes, all attempts; 20 GiB actual free reserve; volume identity and safe ancestors checked before every write
periodic_checks: provenance every 60 seconds after successful check completion, not start; hardware/owner watcher checks unchanged; watcher drains notifications each owner-check cycle
changes: metadata additions, modifications, renames and deletions update accounting; accounting is not content authentication; original scientific hash validation remains mandatory
security: no reparse/cloud paths, no file-content reads by ledger; changes under existing directories have individual notifications; notification loss fails closed
pause_resume: unchanged cooperative checkpoints, partial-stage evidence and safe-exit handshake; fresh observer and full baseline on new process
deployment: DRAFT review only; never applied to existing authorized v3 invocation; future use requires independently reviewed merge and fingerprint-bound human authorization
scientific_change: none; calculations, model identities, thresholds, membership, provenance and scientific output schemas unchanged
